vectors.name: exchange-rate-unsafe-boundary
vectors.note: D5 boundary, also the D6 nearest passing shape: exchangeRate.rate at 9007199254740991 (2^53-1, the largest safe integer) reports clean, hashes, and buildArtifact mints a normal artifact. The D6 failing shape (rate at 2^53 or beyond, 1e300, or a non-finite value from JSON 1e999; likewise a document past the canonicalizer depth or size ceilings) is refused by compute with reason unsafe_number_refused or input_hash_limit_refused at the very top, and buildArtifact mints a refusal artifact (null execution_hash, hash_refusal echoing the named reason) instead of throwing; those shapes cannot be golden vectors because golden-parity hashes policy_parameters and the shared canonicalizer refuses exactly those numbers, so the proptest properties checkUnsafeNumbersRefused and checkBuildArtifactNeverThrows carry the failing shape and this nearest passing shape.
